facts.text: At Park University, historic Mackay Hall was started in 1886 with the help of students who quarried and carried stone from school land to earn their tuition.

sources.title: Park at a Glance | Park University at Parkville, Missouri
sources.quote: It was started in 1886 with the help of students who quarried the stone from the school's land, carried it to the site and helped to build the structure as a means of earning their tuition.
